rule: All ten surviving compounds are the plain colour, sense 1, and the range is the point: an egg white, slaked lime, the sclera, a whiteboard, a half note, a white okra, a photographic mode (ขาวดำ), a building (ทำเนียบขาว), a drug (ผงขาว) and a dismissal (ซองขาว, the white envelope). Sense 3 — แจ่มแจ้ง, สะอาดบริสุทธิ์, the moral reading — stays empty. Thai has the metaphor (ใจขาว, ขาวสะอาด) but it does not build noun compounds on it, the same way หิน's difficulty senses take nothing. An adjectival metaphor and a compounding sense are not the same thing.

senses.vn: A place is named for the feature it has — the feature stands in for the location. That is metonymy rather than metaphor: the marsh, the field, the creek is actually there, and the name points at it.

look.note: NOT a compound of this head: the ผ้าขาวม้า cloth. The dictionary gives ยืมโดยกึ่งเรียนรู้จากเปอร์เซียคลาสสิก کمربند (กะมัรบันด, 'ผ้าคาดเอว') — a semi-learned borrowing from Classical Persian kamarband, 'waist' + 'band'. Neither ขาว 'white' nor ม้า 'horse' is in it.
